caption: The drawing features a detailed illustration of a long-sleeved dress with a full skirt and a fitted bodice, shown in a three-quarter view. The dress is colored with a dark base, predominantly black, and is covered in a floral pattern that incorporates pink, blue, green, and yellow accents. The sleeves end in ruffled cuffs and the skirt has a ruffled hem. On the top right, there is a technical line drawing of the same dress, showing its outline and basic measurements; annotations indicate bust, waist, skirt width, and sleeve length. Below this technical sketch, there is a small sample swatch of the same floral pattern fabric, presented at a “Scale 1:6,” which replicates the colors and design of the main dress but in miniature. The artist’s name, "K. MORRIS," is written at the bottom right corner of the drawing. The entire composition is presented on a plain, off-white sheet with a faint rectangular border framing the illustrated elements.
title: Dress
